verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ ٱلرَّبُّ أَيُّوبَ مِنَ ٱلْعَاصِفَةِ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.web: Then Yahweh answered Job out of the whirlwind,

verses.ar: «مَنْ هَذَا ٱلَّذِي يُظْلِمُ ٱلْقَضَاءَ بِكَلَامٍ بِلَا مَعْرِفَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: Who [is] this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.web: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

verses.ar: اُشْدُدِ ٱلْآنَ حَقْوَيْكَ كَرَجُلٍ، فَإِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَتُعَلِّمُنِي.
verses.kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

verses.ar: أَيْنَ كُنْتَ حِينَ أَسَّسْتُ ٱلْأَرْضَ؟ أَخْبِرْ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ فَهْمٌ.
verses.kjv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.web: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

verses.ar: مَنْ وَضَعَ قِيَاسَهَا؟ لِأَنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ! أَوْ مَنْ مَدَّ عَلَيْهَا مِطْمَارًا؟
verses.kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.web: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

verses.ar: عَلَى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ قَرَّتْ قَوَاعِدُهَا؟ أَوْ مَنْ وَضَعَ حَجَرَ زَاوِيَتِهَا،
verses.kjv: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.web: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

verses.ar: عِنْدَمَا تَرَنَّمَتْ كَوَاكِبُ ٱلصُّبْحِ مَعًا، وَهَتَفَ جَمِيعُ بَنِي ٱللهِ؟
verses.kjv: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.web: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

verses.ar: «وَمَنْ حَجَزَ ٱلْبَحْرَ بِمَصَارِيعَ حِينَ ٱنْدَفَقَ فَخَرَجَ مِنَ ٱلرَّحِمِ.
verses.kjv: Or [who] shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, [as if] it had issued out of the womb?
verses.web: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

verses.ar: إِذْ جَعَلْتُ ٱلسَّحَابَ لِبَاسَهُ، وَٱلضَّبَابَ قِمَاطَهُ،
verses.kjv: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.web: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

verses.ar: وَجَزَمْتُ عَلَيْهِ حَدِّي، وَأَقَمْتُ لَهُ مَغَالِيقَ وَمَصَارِيعَ،
verses.kjv: And brake up for it my decreed [place], and set bars and doors,
verses.web: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

verses.ar: وَقُلْتُ: إِلَى هُنَا تَأْتِي وَلَا تَتَعَدَّى، وَهُنَا تُتْخَمُ كِبْرِيَاءُ لُجَجِكَ؟
verses.kjv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.web: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

verses.ar: «هَلْ فِي أَيَّامِكَ أَمَرْتَ ٱلصُّبْحَ؟ هَلْ عَرَّفْتَ ٱلْفَجْرَ مَوْضِعَهُ
verses.kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; [and] caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.web: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

verses.ar: لِيُمْسِكَ بِأَكْنَافِ ٱلْأَرْضِ، فَيُنْفَضَ ٱلْأَشْرَارُ مِنْهَا؟
verses.kjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.web: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

verses.ar: تَتَحَوَّلُ كَطِينِ ٱلْخَاتِمِ، وَتَقِفُ كَأَنَّهَا لَابِسَةٌ.
verses.kjv: It is turned as clay [to] the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.web: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

verses.ar: وَيُمْنَعُ عَنِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ نُورُهُمْ، وَتَنْكَسِرُ ٱلذِّرَاعُ ٱلْمُرْتَفِعَةُ.
verses.kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.web: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

verses.ar: «هَلِ ٱنْتَهَيْتَ إِلَى يَنَابِيعِ ٱلْبَحْرِ، أَوْ فِي مَقْصُورَةِ ٱلْغَمْرِ تَمَشَّيْتَ؟
verses.kjv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.web: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

verses.ar: هَلِ ٱنْكَشَفَتْ لَكَ أَبْوَابُ ٱلْمَوْتِ، أَوْ عَايَنْتَ أَبْوَابَ ظِلِّ ٱلْمَوْتِ؟
verses.kjv: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.web: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

verses.ar: هَلْ أَدْرَكْتَ عَرْضَ ٱلْأَرْضِ؟ أَخْبِرْ إِنْ عَرَفْتَهُ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.web: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

verses.ar: «أَيْنَ ٱلطَّرِيقُ إِلَى حَيْثُ يَسْكُنُ ٱلنُّورُ؟ وَٱلظُّلْمَةُ أَيْنَ مَقَامُهَا،
verses.kjv: Where [is] the way [where] light dwelleth? and [as for] darkness, where [is] the place thereof,
verses.web: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

verses.ar: حَتَّى تَأْخُذَهَا إِلَى تُخُومِهَا وَتَعْرِفَ سُبُلَ بَيْتِهَا؟
verses.kjv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths [to] the house thereof?
verses.web: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

verses.ar: تَعْلَمُ، لِأَنَّكَ حِينَئِذٍ كُنْتَ قَدْ وُلِدْتَ، وَعَدَدُ أَيَّامِكَ كَثِيرٌ!
verses.kjv: Knowest thou [it], because thou wast then born? or [because] the number of thy days [is] great?
verses.web: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

verses.ar: «أَدَخَلْتَ إِلَى خَزَائِنِ ٱلثَّلْجِ، أَمْ أَبْصَرْتَ مَخَازِنَ ٱلْبَرَدِ،
verses.kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.web: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِي أَبْقَيْتَهَا لِوَقْتِ ٱلضَّرِّ، لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِتَالِ وَٱلْحَرْبِ؟
verses.kjv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.web: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

verses.ar: فِي أَيِّ طَرِيقٍ يَتَوَزَّعُ ٱلنُّورُ، وَتَتَفَرَّقُ ٱلشَّرْقِيَّةُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ؟
verses.kjv: By what way is the light parted, [which] scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.web: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

verses.ar: مَنْ فَرَّعَ قَنَوَاتٍ لِلْهَطْلِ، وَطَرِيقًا لِلصَّوَاعِقِ،
verses.kjv: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.web: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

verses.ar: لِيَمْطُرَ عَلَى أَرْضٍ حَيْثُ لَا إِنْسَانَ، عَلَى قَفْرٍ لَا أَحَدَ فِيهِ،
verses.kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, [where] no man [is; on] the wilderness, wherein [there is] no man;
verses.web: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

verses.ar: لِيُرْوِيَ ٱلْبَلْقَعَ وَٱلْخَلَاءَ وَيُنْبِتَ مَخْرَجَ ٱلْعُشْبِ؟
verses.kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste [ground;] and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.web: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

verses.ar: «هَلْ لِلْمَطَرِ أَبٌ؟ وَمَنْ وَلَدَ مَآجِلَ ٱلطَّلِّ؟
verses.kjv: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.web: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

verses.ar: مِنْ بَطْنِ مَنْ خَرَجَ ٱلْجَمَدُ؟ صَقِيعُ ٱلسَّمَاءِ، مَنْ وَلَدَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.web: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

verses.ar: كَحَجَرٍ صَارَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ. ٱخْتَبَأَتْ. وَتَلَكَّدَ وَجْهُ ٱلْغَمْرِ.
verses.kjv: The waters are hid as [with] a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.web: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

verses.ar: «هَلْ تَرْبِطُ أَنْتَ عُقْدَ ٱلثُّرَيَّا، أَوْ تَفُكُّ رُبُطَ ٱلْجَبَّارِ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.web: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

verses.ar: أَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَنَازِلَ فِي أَوْقَاتِهَا وَتَهْدِي ٱلنَّعْشَ مَعَ بَنَاتِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.web: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

verses.ar: هَلْ عَرَفْتَ سُنَنَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ، أَوْ جَعَلْتَ تَسَلُّطَهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ؟
verses.kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.web: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

verses.ar: أَتَرْفَعُ صَوْتَكَ إِلَى ٱلسُّحُبِ فَيُغَطِّيَكَ فَيْضُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.web: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

verses.ar: أَتُرْسِلُ ٱلْبُرُوقَ فَتَذْهَبَ وَتَقُولَ لَكَ: هَا نَحْنُ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we [are]?
verses.web: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

verses.ar: مَنْ وَضَعَ فِي ٱلطَّخَاءِ حِكْمَةً، أَوْ مَنْ أَظْهَرَ فِي ٱلشُّهُبِ فِطْنَةً؟
verses.kjv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.web: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

verses.ar: مَنْ يُحْصِي ٱلْغُيُومَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ، وَمَنْ يَسْكُبُ أَزْقَاقَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ،
verses.kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.web: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

verses.ar: إِذْ يَنْسَبِكُ ٱلتُّرَابُ سَبْكًا وَيَتَلَاصَقُ ٱلْمَدَرُ؟
verses.kjv: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.web: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

verses.ar: «أَتَصْطَادُ لِلَّبْوَةِ فَرِيسَةً، أَمْ تُشْبِعُ نَفْسَ ٱلْأَشْبَالِ،
verses.kjv: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.web: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

verses.ar: حِينَ تَجْرَمِزُّ فِي عِرِّيسِهَا وَتَجْلِسُ فِي عِيصِهَا لِلْكُمُونِ؟
verses.kjv: When they couch in [their] dens, [and] abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.web: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

verses.ar: مَنْ يُهَيِّئُ لِلْغُرَابِ صَيْدَهُ، إِذْ تَنْعَبُ فِرَاخُهُ إِلَى ٱللهِ، وَتَتَرَدَّدُ لِعَدَمِ ٱلْقُوتِ؟
verses.kjv: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.web: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
